summary: Subcontractor COI & paperwork tracking for general contractors — read-only demo tools.

toolsPreview.name: search_sub_docs
toolsPreview.description: Search subcontractor documents by sub name or document type. Returns matching records with expiry date and status (on file, needs check, not received, lapsed).

toolsPreview.name: list_uninsured_subs
toolsPreview.description: List subcontractors with lapsed or missing insurance documents — the ones creating liability exposure right now. Most dangerous first.

toolsPreview.name: get_expiring_cover
toolsPreview.description: List subcontractor documents expiring within the next N days (default 30) so certificates can be renewed before a sub goes uncovered.

toolsPreview.name: get_compliance_summary
toolsPreview.description: Get the subcontractor compliance summary: totals for tracked, not received, lapsed cover, lapsing this week, and awaiting check.

toolsPreview.name: export_compliance_report
toolsPreview.description: Export the full subcontractor compliance report as CSV text (sub, document, due date, status, request history).
